魂が解けていく。

pages.en:
—The body dissolves.

The heart melts.

The soul comes undone.
pages.mirrorMoon:
My
body is melting.
My
mind is melting.
My soul is melting.

夥しく貪欲に、一部の隙もなく網羅しようと捕獲する。
「ぁ

pages.en:
“Ah—”

Black fingers coil around me.

Innumerable and ravenous, they seize me, seeking to cover every part and leave no opening.

“Ah—”

My body falls into black mud.

The sea's surface recedes far above me. I sink without end.

Carefully, methodically, the fingers tighten their embrace until not the smallest gap remains.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Agh
”
The black fingers wrap around me.
It tries to eat abundantly and greedily, without the slightest opening.
“Ah
”
My body falls into a sea of black mud.
The surface is far away, and I sink without end.
It reinforces and embraces me, carefully and without exception.

pages.en:
“——”

My arms and legs are gone.

Dyed utterly black, made part of that thing, I fall toward a terminus in the depths.

My limbs disappear.
My body turns black, and I become a part of it and fall downward to my final destination.
